description: Deterministically step a .prt effect in Node (no rendering) and report per-layer live counts over time, peak vs capacity, spatial bounds, completion, and a statehash plus the exact {seed, dt, steps} to reproduce it. Same seed + dt sequence => identical output. Validates first; an invalid doc returns validate-shaped errors.

doc.description: The .prt document as a JSON string.

dt.description: Fixed timestep. Default 1/60; clamped to [0.001, 0.05] (the runtime MAX_DT).

duration.description: Seconds to simulate. Default 3; capped at 60.

handle.description: A handle from open_effect — use instead of doc to avoid resending the document.

sampleInterval.description: Seconds between count samples. Default 0.1; floor 0.001, widened if it would emit more than 4096 samples.

seed.description: Override the doc's authored seed. Default: the doc's seed.

name: simulate_effect

bounds.description: Axis-aligned bounds over every live particle across the run; null if none ever spawned.

completed.description: True if the effect reached isDone (one-shots); false for looping/unfinished.

completionTime.description: Seconds at which isDone first held; null if never.

echo.description: The exact inputs used after defaulting/clamping — replay these for an identical statehash.

overBudget.description: True when peakLive reached capacity — the pool clipped emission.

statehash.description: hex8 FNV-1a over the final public sim state — reproducible per {seed, dt, steps}.

title: Simulate Effect
